findings.summary: Candidate (PC 3-class (teacher of the ESP32 candidate)) retrained on the RK45-integrated dataset (R3/R4, after S-16/S-18), same recipe as the promoted run. Not promoted; the registry is unchanged.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid, DC plant integrated with RK45); no real-machine validation exists.
